title: Damage Approval Limit and the Seller's Store Plan, FBN
content:
**Limit.** The damage approval limit on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) warehouse-damage case is the large-store damage limit of 40 units for a seller whose selling plan is Anchor Store or Enterprise Store, and the mid-store damage limit of 20 units for Basic Store or Premium Store. A seller on any other selling plan has no limit set by this clause.

The selling plan is the seller's current plan on their Selling Plans record.

**Basis questions.**

*Does a seller on Premium Store get the 40-unit limit?* No. Premium Store takes the mid-store damage limit of 20 units; 40 units is for Anchor Store and Enterprise Store.

*Does the date the store plan was opened matter?* No. Only the plan itself is read.

*What limit does this clause set for a plan other than the four named?* None.
